title: Locker Rental: monthly and daily-use fee billing rule
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states the rule by which a rental is billed a recurring fee, and the condition a rental's status must satisfy before any such charge may be recorded. The specific monthly fee, member discount percentage, daily-use fee, and maximum consecutive daily-use days that this rule reads for a given tier are fixed in the Locker Rental monthly rate and membership discount terms and in the Locker Rental daily-use rental terms; this document states only the charging rule itself.

## Rule
At activation, and again at each billing cycle thereafter, the rental is charged the tier's monthly fee as a recurring monthly charge, reduced by the tier's member discount percentage where the member's club membership tier qualifies for that discount. For a tier where daily use is permitted, the rental is instead charged that tier's daily-use fee for each day used, up to the maximum number of consecutive days permitted for daily use before a monthly rental would be required in its place.

## Eligibility: rental must be open to be charged
A charge may be recorded against the rental only while the rental's status is active or past due, as shown by the system's own record of the rental. A charge is not written against a rental in any other status.

## Equivalent restatement
- Condition: the rental's system-recorded status is active or past due at the time of the charge.
- Judgement: the charge qualifies to be recorded.
- Otherwise (any other status): the charge does not qualify to be recorded.

## Truth table (hypothetical, over the rental's status at the time a charge would be recorded)
| Rental status | May a charge be recorded? |
|---|---|
| Applied (not yet activated) | No |
| Active | Yes |
| Past due | Yes |
| Closed | No |

## Points of judgement
The member discount percentage reduces the tier's own monthly fee for that same rental; it does not create a separate charge, and it does not apply to a daily-use charge, since a daily-use tier is billed instead of, not in addition to, the monthly-fee mechanism.
